description: Emitted to draw attention to a resource: to one of its annotations, or, with no annotation, to the resource as a whole. The resource is always named. A focus on an annotation scrolls a viewer showing that resource to it, and a viewer showing a different resource ignores it — a deliberate ignore rather than a silent no-op. A focus on the resource as a whole brings that resource forward, opened if it is not open, at its top.

resourceId.description: The resource this focus applies to, always named. With an annotation it is a guard: a viewer showing a different resource ignores the event. With none it is the resource the focus brings forward.
